documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Exim Routes reported a 72% year-on-year increase in FY26 revenue to Rs. 207 crores and a 38% increase in EBITDA to Rs. 14.1 crores, driven primarily by volume expansion. Management guided for 30% to 50% revenue growth in FY27, aiming to hit Rs. 300 crores at the upper end.

guidance.claim: The company targets 30% to 50% revenue and bottom-line growth for FY27, aiming for Rs. 300 crores of revenue at the upper end.
guidance.quote: For the full-year FY27, our business target is 30% to 50% of revenue growth, top line and bottom line, aiming to hit 300 crores of revenue at the upper end.

demand_outlook.claim: India is one of the biggest users of recyclable paper raw material, importing 6 million tons worth around $1.5 to $2 billion annually from over 50 countries.
demand_outlook.quote: India is one of the biggest users of recyclable paper raw material. The country imports 6 million tons, that is 600 crore kgs of recyclable paper worth around $15 to $2 billion annually. And that too from 50 plus countries.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian market for recycled paper imports is valued at Rs. 15,000 crores and growing.
demand_outlook.quote: the India market for recycled paper imports is Rs. 15,000 crores and growing, right?

orders_capacity.claim: Exim Routes works with more than 30 paper mills in India and sources over 150,000 metric tons of raw material annually from more than 25 countries.
orders_capacity.quote: EXIM Routes is working with more than 30 paper mills in India and sources more than 150,000 metric tons of raw material annually from more than 25 countries.

orders_capacity.claim: The company handles almost 20,000 kgs of recyclable material every hour.
orders_capacity.quote: To give you a sense of our scale as we speak, EXIM Routes is handling almost 20,000 kgs of recyclable material every hour.

orders_capacity.claim: The company moved around 6,000 containers annually supported by over 25 global logistic partners and aims to scale to 10,000 containers this year.
orders_capacity.quote: We are currently moving around 6,000 containers annually, supported by more than 25 global logistic partners. And our aim is to scale to 10,000 containers this year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company onboarded invoice financing partners with initial limits of 2.5 crores and aims to expand it to 15 crores this year.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already started the process of onboarding invoice financing partners with initial limits of 2.5 crores and we aim it to expand to 15 crores this year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth roughly tripled to Rs. 68.7 crore rupees following the December IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net worth has roughly tripled to Rs. 68.7 crore rupees following our December IPO.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt as of 31st March was close to Rs. 16 crores against bank balances of more than Rs. 17 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March, the total debt that we had was close to Rs. 16 crores against bank balances of more than Rs. 17 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow was negative approximately minus 19 crores in FY26 against minus 5 crores the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: our operating cash flow was negative in FY26, approximately minus 19 crores, against minus 5 crores the previous year

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised Rs. 43.7 crores through the IPO, which net of expenses was around Rs. 37.2 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On the IPO proceeds, a very quick word, we raised Rs. 43.7 crores, which net of expenses was around Rs. 37.2 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global oil prices have been elevated in the last quarter, pushing freight costs and cost of services across routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Also, as most people are aware, oil prices globally have been elevated in the last quarter, which have further pushed freight costs and cost of services across the route.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to scale shipping containers from 6,000 to 10,000 containers this year.
management_commitments.quote: We are currently moving around 6,000 containers annually, supported by more than 25 global logistic partners. And our aim is to scale to 10,000 containers this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to expand invoice financing limits from 2.5 crores to 15 crores this year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already started the process of onboarding invoice financing partners with initial limits of 2.5 crores and we aim it to expand to 15 crores this year.

management_commitments.claim: In the medium term, the objective remains to move towards operating cash flow positive as the business scales.
management_commitments.quote: In the medium term, our objective still remains to move towards operating cash flow positive as we scale.

management_commitments.claim: Long term, the company wants to be a top three global player in the space and capture around 8% to 10% of the recycled paper import market share.
management_commitments.quote: we believe that in the longer term, we want to be a top three global player in the space and capture around 8% to 10% of that market share.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets achieving a Rs. 1,000 crore top-line milestone as part of its five-year vision.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, absolutely. Absolutely. We totally see this as a five-year vision.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
